title: Partner catalog sandbox entry checklist and copy lab
content:
Purpose:
A compact working playbook for the partner catalog sandbox pilot. This doc is intentionally terse — meant for the sprint team building the first 6 catalog tiles for pilot partners. Combines copy experiments, technical gating checklist, legal/compliance signals, and an ops rollout runbook.

Scope:
- Pilot scope: 6 partner tiles, two verticals (dev tools, data integrations).
- Environments: sandbox (catalog-dev) -> staging -> pilot-prod (us-east-1).
- Objective: validate listing acceptance flow, telemetry, and conversion copy under real user traffic in a controlled pilot.

Quick summary: what we need to ship this sprint
- Finalized short and long tile copy for 6 partners (A/B: 'technical' vs 'value')
- SKU mapping + trial entitlement doc for partner billing
- Security checklist completed with partner security contact
- SSO + KMS smoke tests for Private deployment suppliers (if applicable)
- Telemetry events instrumented (impressions, click-to-start, trial-provision)

Sprint TODOs (owners in-line):
- Copy: create 2 short variants + 1 long variant per tile (Aisha) — due 2025-11-10
- UX samples: hero image + 2 alt screenshots per tile (Marco) — due 2025-11-14
- Technical: SKU mapping spreadsheet & entitlement API contract (Emily) — due 2025-11-12
- Security: partner security questionnaire review (Jonas) — due 2025-11-15
- Ops: telemetry hook + sample dashboard (SRE) — due 2025-11-18

Copy snippets (short, for tile header) — experiment variants, keep < 70 chars:
- Variant A (technical): "Low-latency LLM inference with predictable cost per token"
- Variant B (value): "Ship LLM features faster — scale reliably, save on tokens"
- Trial badge text: "Free pilot: 30k tokens / 14 days"

Copy: long description (example, keep ~2–3 short paragraphs):
- Draft long copy (neutral tone): "Redwood Inference partners with [Partner] to offer a managed integration that connects your app to production-grade LLM inference. The integration supports streaming, function-calling, and predictable throughput. Configure reserved capacity, or run on-demand with transparent token-based pricing. Use the dashboard to trace requests, set rollouts, and monitor cost per route."
- CTA variations: "Try in sandbox", "Start a free pilot", "Request enterprise terms"

Microcopy guidelines:
- Avoid model brand claims (e.g., "GPT-like") — use capability-first language ("modern open LLMs").
- If partner provides vertical claims (e.g., "clinical quality"), add mandatory legal tag: "subject to partner accuracy SLA" and route to legal review.

Technical acceptance checklist (must be green to list tile in pilot-prod):
- [ ] Tile metadata fields present: short_title, long_description, hero_image_url, tags, sku_id
- [ ] SKU maps to entitlement code in billing spreadsheet
- [ ] Trial provisioning API returns 200 and creates a sandbox project (end-to-end smoke)
- [ ] Telemetry events emitted: catalog.impression, catalog.click, entitlement.granted, run.started
- [ ] Rate-limit guardrails applied at tenant level (defaults: 100 rps burst, 20 sustained)
- [ ] Model variant fallbacks configured (small/medium/large family) and tested for degraded capacity
- [ ] Regional residency tag set (us-east-1 | eu-west-1) and data residency notes attached if non-default

Legal & compliance gating (quick pass/fail checklist):
- [ ] NDA or partner MSA in place if listing contains PII handling language
- [ ] Privacy note included in tile if partner captures or stores user inputs
- [ ] KMS integration validated if customer-managed keys requested
- [ ] Export control and regional restrictions documented for partner-specific models

Acceptance criteria for go/no-go to pilot-prod:
- Copy A/B has > 8% uplift in trial clickthrough vs baseline in sandbox (3 days of synthetic traffic) OR stakeholder sign-off to proceed
- All 'must' technical checks are done and smoke flows pass repeatedly (3 smoke runs over different tokens)
- No open blockers from security (severity >= P0)

Telemetry & metrics to instrument (minimum):
- catalog.impression: tile_id, variant, region, user_type
- catalog.click: tile_id, variant, timestamp
- entitlement.request: sku_id, partner_id, response_time_ms, success
- trial.onboarded: tenant_id, tokens_allocated, started_at
- Ops dashboard: 1-min QPS, 95th p99 token latency, failed entitlements per 1k

Rollout plan (phased):
1) internal sandbox: smoke and copy QA (days 0–3)
2) partner pilot in sandbox with traffic steering (days 3–7)
3) limited pilot-prod release (5% traffic) with close ops watch (days 7–14)
4) full pilot-prod (all pilot tenants) if no regressions (day 14+)

Risk mitigations and rollback triggers:
- Auto-fallback: if entitlement API error rate > 2% for 10m, revert catalog route to internal-default tile
- Copy-related legal hold: if partner legal flags unvetted claims, remove long_description and append "Under review"
- Cost spike guardrail: if token spend for pilot > 2x forecasted, throttle non-critical routes and notify finance

Owners & contact matrix:
- Product & copy owner: Aisha Patel — aisha@redwood.com
- Technical/SDK contact: Emily Zhao — emily@redwood.com
- Partner security: Jonas Müller — jonas@redwood.com
- SRE/Telemetry: Marco Hernandez — marco@redwood.com

Open questions / notes to resolve:
- Billing: do partners want consolidated billing or direct marketplace billing? (JIRA-9012)
- Residency: which partners must be restricted to private-deployments (legal review needed)
- Visual assets: can partners provide screenshots sized 1200x628? If not, we need templated placeholders
- Accessibility: ensure tile alt-text present for hero images (low priority but add to backlog)

Quick links + references:
- Confluence: CONFLUENCE-1234 (catalog listing guide)
- Jira epic: JIRA-9012 (sandboxes + entitlement)
- PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/marketplace-ux/pull/78

Next steps (this sprint):
- Final copy variants locked by 2025-11-10 (Aisha)
- Run sandbox A/B synthetic test for 3 days starting 2025-11-15 (SRE + Product)
- Complete technical checklist and sign-off 2025-11-18 (Engineering)

Notes to self (informal):
- Keep phrasing simple; legal hates 'guarantee' and 'best-in-class' — use measurable claims only.
- Save previous copy iterations in /notes/copy-archive for audit.
- Expect follow-ups from finance on how trial entitlements map to invoices.

End of doc.
